events.title: 왓퍼드 rout 웨스트햄 유나이티드 5–0 in an important game at the foot of the First Division. In the Second Division, Gordon Owen scores a hat-trick as 반즐리 beat 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 3–0.

In a match touted as the "title decider," 에버턴 beat 토트넘 홋스퍼 2–1 at White Hart Lane. Andy Gray and Trevor Steven score in each half to put 에버턴 in control before Graham Roberts pulls a goal back. Neville Southall denies the home side a point with a breathtaking late save from Mark Falco . The win takes 에버턴 four points clear with two matches in hand on 맨체스터 유나이티드 who leapfrog Spurs into second after a 2–1 win over 레스터 시티. 이언 러시 scores after 52 seconds to set 리버풀 on course for a 3–0 win at 선덜랜드.

에버턴 come from behind to beat 선덜랜드 4–1 and maintain their lead on the chasing pack. 맨체스터 유나이티드 hammer 스토크 시티 5–0 but 토트넘 홋스퍼 are held to a 1–1 draw at 웨스트햄 유나이티드. 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 go top of Division Two on goal difference thanks to a 2–0 win at 카디프 시티 in which leading scorer John Aldridge bags his 27th goal of the season.

선덜랜드 drop into the relegation zone following their goalless draw with 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 and away victories for 입스위치 타운 and 루턴 타운. 웨스트햄 유나이티드 are drawn further into the mire after a 4–2 defeat at 퀸스 파크 레인저스. In the Second Division, 포츠머스 move up to second by winning 3–1 at 풀럼 as 맨체스터 시티 are beaten at home by 리즈 유나이티드.
맨체스터 유나이티드 suffer a major setback in their pursuit of leaders 에버턴 as they slip to a 1–0 defeat at 셰필드 웬즈데이.

리버풀 virtually book their place in next month's European Cup final with a 4–0 win over 파나시나이코스 . In the Cup Winners' Cup, 에버턴 come away from the first leg of their semi-final against 바이에른 뮌헨 with an encouraging goalless draw.

FA Cup holders 에버턴 reach the final by beating 루턴 타운 2–1 at Villa Park . An 85th minute Kevin Sheedy free kick cancels out Ricky Hill 's first half strike and Derek Mountfield scores the winner near the end of extra time. In the other semi-final at Goodison Park, 리버풀 twice come from behind to take 맨체스터 유나이티드 to a replay. The situation at the foot of the First Division tightens further with 선덜랜드's 1–0 win at 코번트리 시티 the most notable result. In Division Two, a David Geddis hat-trick helps 버밍엄 시티 to a 3–1 win at Fratton Park which lifts the Blues above Pompey into second.
케임브리지 유나이티드 suffer a second successive relegation following a 2–1 defeat at 밀월. The U's have won only seven league matches in total since the start of last season.

맨체스터 유나이티드 beat 리버풀 2–1 in a stirring FA Cup semi-final replay at Maine Road . 토트넘 홋스퍼's lingering title hopes suffer another blow as 아스널 beat them 2–0 at White Hart Lane, Spurs' fourth defeat in their last five home matches.

Leaders 에버턴 beat bottom side 스토크 시티 2–0 at the Victoria Ground. The result confirms the Potters' relegation having accumulated just three wins and 17 points from 35 league matches. 토트넘 홋스퍼 lose at home again, 3–2 to 입스위치 타운. Barely two years after almost going out of business, 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 stand on the brink of promotion to the First Division after beating 올덤 애슬레틱 5–2 with John Aldridge scoring a hat-trick.
루턴 타운 climb out of the relegation zone with a 2–1 win over 맨체스터 유나이티드. Both of their goals are scored by Mick Harford .

브래드퍼드 시티 win 4–0 at 케임브리지 유나이티드 to clinch promotion from the Third Division while 헐 시티 look like joining them following a 4–1 win at 프레스턴 노스 엔드 that gives them a cushion of 11 points over fourth-placed 브리스틀 시티 .

A 마크 로런슨 goal in Greece completes a comfortable 5–0 aggregate win for 리버풀 over 파나시나이코스 in the European Cup. Their opponents in next month's final will be Italian champions 유벤투스. 에버턴 reach their first European final with a 3–1 win over 바이에른 뮌헨 at Goodison Park in the Cup Winners' Cup. 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 beat 슈루즈버리 타운 1–0 and are promoted to the First Division.

에버턴 beat 노리치 시티 3–0 and need only five points from their remaining seven matches to be certain of the title. 코번트리 시티 boost their survival hopes with a 2–1 win over 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 but 선덜랜드 remain in deep trouble despite holding 맨체스터 유나이티드 to a 2–2 draw at Old Trafford. 노먼 화이트사이드 misses a penalty. At Stamford Bridge, 첼시 introduce their new "electric fence" aimed at combating hooliganism. They draw 1–1 with 토트넘 홋스퍼 and the fence is not switched on. 버밍엄 시티's 1–0 win at 반즐리 puts them on the verge of an immediate return to the First Division but the third promotion spot is still up for grabs. 블랙번 로버스 lose 1–0 at 찰턴 애슬레틱 so 맨체스터 시티 move into the driving seat with a 2–1 win at 포츠머스 while 리즈 유나이티드 keep their faint hopes alive by beating 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 1–0.
